# Show Me Epoxy

> Professional epoxy and polyaspartic floor coating contractor based in Jefferson City, Missouri, serving homeowners and businesses across Mid-Missouri. Every floor is mechanically diamond ground before any coating is applied.

Show Me Epoxy serves residential homeowners, commercial businesses, and property owners across Mid-Missouri including Cole, Boone, Callaway, Miller, Camden, Morgan, Phelps, and Pettis counties.

We are known for our prep-first installation process — every floor is mechanically diamond ground before any coating is applied. This creates a mechanical bond that box store kits and acid-etched floors cannot match.

Owner: Eric (founder, lead installer)

## What Makes Us Different

- Diamond grinding on every single job — no exceptions
- Industrial-grade materials, not consumer box store products
- Polyaspartic UV-stable topcoat on every floor, so it will not yellow
- Full broadcast flake system — colour goes all the way to the edges
- Free on-site quotes with physical colour samples brought to every appointment
- 1-day installation on most residential garage floors
- 27 flake colour options including standard and hybrid blends

## Frequently Asked Questions

- [How long does an epoxy garage floor last?](https://showmeepoxy.com/blog-how-long-does-an-epoxy-garage-floor-last.html): A properly installed epoxy floor with a polyaspartic topcoat lasts 15+ years with normal use. The key is diamond grinding the concrete before coating so the system bonds mechanically rather than only adhesively.
- [How much does an epoxy garage floor cost?](https://showmeepoxy.com/calculator.html): Pricing depends on square footage, concrete condition, repairs, coating system, and finish. Use the calculator for a ballpark, then book a free on-site quote.
- [How long does installation take?](https://showmeepoxy.com/blog-how-long-epoxy-installation-takes.html): Most residential garage floors are completed in a single day. The floor is typically ready for light foot traffic within 4-6 hours and vehicle traffic within 24 hours.
- [What is the difference between epoxy and polyaspartic?](https://showmeepoxy.com/type-polyaspartic.html): Epoxy is the base coating that provides colour, flake, and the primary bond. Polyaspartic is the topcoat — UV-stable so it will not yellow, extremely hard, chemical resistant, and fast-curing. We use both.
- [What is diamond grinding and why does it matter?](https://showmeepoxy.com/blog-why-diamond-grinding-matters.html): Diamond grinding mechanically abrades the concrete surface, opening the pores so the coating bonds into a profile. Without it, coatings rely on adhesion alone and frequently peel or delaminate.
- [What colours are available?](https://showmeepoxy.com/colors.html): 27 signature flake blends including standard and hybrid multi-chip-size systems. Custom blends are also available.
- [Can you coat a basement floor?](https://showmeepoxy.com/service-basement.html): Yes. We use moisture-tolerant primer systems where a slab needs one.
- [Do you serve the Lake of the Ozarks?](https://showmeepoxy.com/area-lake-ozarks.html): Yes, including Osage Beach, Camdenton, Eldon, and Versailles across Miller, Morgan, and Camden counties.
